about_the_game:
The main character is an unfulfilled chef who can cook anything. One day, his life turns upside down when his food begins to turn into different girls, evening after evening.

A cute and cozy game about cooking and dating. Cook different food in interesting games, and then spend unforgettable evenings with different consequences with cute girls.

A cozy and beautiful game. We tried very hard to create a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere through a unique visual style, pleasant music and moderate difficulty.

Characters for all tastes. All the girls have their own unique personalities that match the food they embody. Each has her own backstory, thoughts and concerns.

A young worker in her family's store. Maybe this is not an ordinary store, and maybe she is not an ordinary girl. Get to know her better in a big romance story. Perhaps she will be the one who can give you happiness.

Warm and caring in the daytime, hot at night. Saves her delicious juiciness for "that one". She does not tolerate careless treatment, but is ready to give herself completely to someone who has put his soul into her.

A headstrong and proud girl. It won't be easy to reach her feminine nature, but it's worth it. Cold but elegant, just as sushi should be. Familiar with a bright life, but maybe she wants something else?​​​

A really hot girl. Maybe that's the hotness you need in your life right now? This girl can amuse you if you play with her.

More interesting and unique characters are coming. We can't wait to get them into the game and show it to you!

The girls are voiced on all dates. Authentic voice acting with russian girls. Spend a good time with their gentle voices.

Different endings and unique scenes for each character. Open all endings to unlock the secret one.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains nudity and sexual scenes.

short_description: Sushi, pasta, dumplings and other food have turned into girls and want to spend a romantic nights with you. A pleasant, relaxing and funny novel, where you will have to cook a variety of dinners from all over the world, chat with unusual girls and do "other" things with them...
